referenceRole: Selected mobile-first dialog mockup, palette and empty interior background
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: ONE finished production raster background asset for the Fishius mobile game level-up dialog.
Primary request: Generate only the EMPTY CREAM INTERIOR BACKGROUND from the attached approved mockup. Output opaque PNG approximately 2048 x 768 pixels, landscape 8:3 aspect ratio, edge-to-edge background. This is an isolated background asset, not a screenshot or a mockup.
Reference image role: visual style and palette reference only. The relevant cream interior rectangle in the reference is approximately x160, y194, width1525, height574 within the 1844x852 source. Recreate its quiet pale warm ivory and very subtle pale seafoam at the far left and right edges, with all foreground objects removed.
Scene/backdrop: Extremely subtle smooth diffuse illumination, warm cream #fffdf0 across most of the canvas, especially the entire left third and broad center. A faint cool seafoam tint confined to the far outer edges may echo the reference. Two very tiny soft pale blue bubbles may appear only in the far upper right corner.

Constraints: Fully opaque, no alpha transparency, no checkerboard. No visible texture, grain, speckles, noise, rays, mottling, or paper effect. No rocks, seaweed, plants, fish, shells, badge, medal, cards, text, letters, numbers, borders, shadows, divider, buttons, controls, dots or HUD. No title or label. No white surround, margins, device frame or presentation board. Do not reproduce the interface from the reference.
Intended consumer: stretched inside a shared dialog body behind a fixed left reward receipt and right item gallery, approximately 690x250 logical pixels on a landscape phone. Most of the asset must remain nearly flat warm cream to blend with an existing cream-backed badge.
